bio: In this restaurant in the upper reaches of the city, a rather elegant yet relaxed atmosphere awaits you. The kitchen team showcases in-season regional produce in really delicious dishes. While Ronny Zipfel presides in the kitchen, maître d' Nicolas Schumnik heads up the experienced front-of-house team. In summer, head for the leafy terrace. Tip: It is easy to get here by taking the no 10 tram or the Funicular Rigiblick.
